findings.evidence: Vue Router warning on S1-04 navigation: '[Vue Router warn]: Discarded invalid param(s) "categoryId" when navigating'. Source: vendor.js:31589 (vue-router 4.1.4). Triggered because the spec passes `params: { categoryId: String(cid) }` to a route whose param is configured WITHOUT explicit name match (the route name may be `kiosk.products` with no categoryId param declared, or the route declaration uses a different name like 'categoryID' camelCase). NO user-facing impact — the right product list still rendered (S1-04 PNG shows 'SANDWICH CAYENNE' content correctly). NEW vs wave-final-2026-05-23 (likely a Vue Router minor version upgrade or route-name refactor between the two rounds). Real-user clicks on a category tile dispatch the right param shape via router.push from KioskCategories — this is a test-harness-only artifact.
findings.fix_hint: Test spec can be tightened to use the canonical kiosk.products param name (verify in resources/js/router/kiosk.js). Real-product code does NOT need to change.
findings.dispute_outcome: kept as INFO — surfaced for reviewer transparency. Real-user UX is unaffected (page renders correctly). If wave triggers re-run, spec author can fix the harness param shape.
findings.applied: no — read-only mode + product code unaffected

findings.evidence: Cart lines show fallback emoji 🍽️ instead of product photo for Cheddar + Tacos. DOM shows `🍽️` — the KioskCartComponent's image-or-emoji fallback resolved to emoji because the test injected lines via store.dispatch('kioskCart/addItem', {...}) WITHOUT `image_full_url`. In real-user flow, the wizard's AJOUTER AU PANIER button builds the line with image_full_url preserved from the Item model. Confirmed by inspecting line shape in test code (spec line 234-249, buildLine() omits image fields).
findings.fix_hint: No product-code change needed. If future rounds want product photos visible in cart capture, spec can copy `image_full_url` + `image_url` + `image` from the item before dispatching addItem. NOT scope-minimal.
findings.dispute_outcome: kept as INFO — pure test artifact, real-user UX is correct (wizard wires the image). Surfaced so future reviewers don't mis-classify as a cart regression.
findings.applied: no — test-harness-only, no product code change
